translationRepairs: In the third year of Tiancheng (562), he was promoted to advising officer of the northern expedition and concurrently supervisor of the court of ceremonial rites.
In the third year of Tianjia (562), he was promoted to advising officer of the northern expedition and concurrently supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review.
s0051 has 天嘉三年 and 廷尉監; Tiancheng and ceremonial rites misread the Chen era name and the judicial office, and the proposed idiomatic replacement is accurate.
In the third year of Tiancheng, he was promoted to advising officer of the Northern Expedition and concurrently supervisor of the Court of Ceremonial Rites.
In the third year of Tianjia, he was promoted to advising officer of the Northern Expedition and concurrently supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review.
Same unit: 天嘉 is Tianjia and 廷尉監 is the Court of Judicial Review supervisorship, not ceremonial rites; the proposed literal replacement matches the Chinese.

In the fourth year of Zhide (586) he died; Houzhu mourned him long and issued an edict: "Care in the end and remembrance of the distant, reverence for old norms, closing the coffin and fixing the posthumous title—these suppress former canons.

In the fourth year of Zhide (586) he died; Houzhu mourned him long and issued an edict: "Care in the end and remembrance of the distant, reverence for old norms, closing the coffin and fixing the posthumous title—these are indeed the former canons.
In the edict clause 抑乃前典, 抑乃 affirms that coffin-closing and posthumous titles are indeed the former canons; reading 抑 as 'suppress' reverses the sense, and the proposed wording restores it.
